2608.02454.title: Infinite Trace Objectives with Finite Trace Techniques: Translating LTL to LTLf+
2608.02454.paper_summary: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) is one of the most widely adopted languages for specifying temporal extended objectives in AI, with applications ranging from reactive synthesis to stochastic planning in Markov decision processes and reinforcement learning. Traditionally, solving any of these problems requires translating the LTL specification to a nondeterministic automata on infinite words and then determinizing it, a step that is notoriously difficult in theory and in practice. Recent work has introduced LTLf+, which lifts the finite-trace logic LTLf to infinite traces. LTLf+ has the same expressive power as LTL, yet it retains most of the crucial advantages of its base logic LTLf. Most reasoning in LTLf+ rests on finite automata on finite words, for which we have not only a canonical minimal representation but also an efficient determinization procedure. In this work we present the first translation from LTL to LTLf+. We first normalize an LTL formula into the syntactic reactivity fragment of the Manna-Pnueli hierarchy, to create the general fragment-based shape of LTLf+. We then present linear translations for each individual component of that fragment. As a consequence of this translation, the expanding body of techniques developed for LTLf+ now becomes available to many AI problems currently formulated in LTL. We further show that this comes at no asymptotic cost, as the pipeline from LTL to automaton via LTLf+ remains doubly exponential.
2608.02454.paper_summary_zh: 線性時間邏輯（LTL）是指定AI中時間擴展目標的最廣泛採用語言之一，其應用範圍從反應合成到馬可夫決策過程和強化學習中的隨機規劃。傳統上，解決這些問題的任何方法都需要將LTL規範轉換為無窮字的非確定性自動機，然後進行確定化，這一步在理論和實踐中都是著名的困難。最近的研究引入了LTLf+，它將有限跡邏輯LTLf提升到無窮跡。LTLf+具有與LTL相同的表達能力，但保留了其基礎邏輯LTLf的大多數關鍵優勢。LTLf+中的大多數推理依賴於有限字的有限自動機，對於這些自動機，我們不僅擁有一個典範的最小表示，還有一個高效的確定化程序。在這項工作中，我們提出了從LTL到LTLf+的首次轉換。我們首先將LTL公式標準化為Manna-Pnueli層次結構的語法反應片段，以創建LTLf+的一般片段基礎形狀。然後，我們為該片段的每個單獨組件提出線性轉換。作為這一轉換的結果，為LTLf+開發的日益增長的技術體系現在可用於許多目前以LTL形式表述的AI問題。我們進一步表明，這並不會帶來漸近成本，因為從LTL到自動機通過LTLf+的過程仍然是雙指數級的。
